direct_document.description: Use the uploaded document directly in the prompt/context. Best for one small policy, FAQ, SOP, or rule document.

vectorless.description: Chunk documents and retrieve by lexical keyword overlap without embeddings or a vector index. Best for small support collections where exact terms matter.

vector_db.description: Chunk documents, create embeddings, and retrieve relevant chunks. Best for many customer-support documents.

enterprise.description: Large-scale RAG with ingestion pipeline, permissions, metadata filters, re-ranking, evals, and observability. Not implemented yet.
